Show highlights

Live stages

Discover what your favourite chefs and experts are cooking this summer as they cook dishes live. You’ll be spoilt for choice with our star-studded line-up including James Martin, Si King, John Torode, Lisa Faulkner and more!

Meet the stars

Get a cookbook signed by chefs and experts at the Show. You can even snap a selfie!

Get hands-on

Book an extra experience to learn new skills and have fun with friends including Cocktail Masterclasses, Fabulous Food Finds Tastings and the chance to sit at Adam Frost’s Tasting Table with Si King, Lisa Faulkner or artisan cheese maker Rennet & Rind!

Shopping

Explore unusual artisan producers alongside favourite  brands – taste the products, get great show ofers and meet the people behind the food and drink.

what's on

BBC Gardeners' World Live included in your ticket

For more than 15 years, these two great shows have taken place together, at the same time – one ticket gives you entry to both of these incredible days out – it’s why we have a 2-day ticket!

You’ll be inspired to grow your own healthy and honest ingredients, take your outdoor living to the max and get practical tips to get onto the gardening ladder with famous faces from Gardeners’ World including including Monty Don.

Frequently asked questions

Where can I find ticket information and prices for 2026?

We are delighted to announce that we will be back from the 18-21 June 2026 for an unmissable summer Show. Tickets are now on sale, book here.

Click here to see the full details.

Do you have special rates for children?

Under 16s go FREE at the weekend – a great value day out for families!

Kids aged 0-5 FREE every day, and aged 6-17 tickets cost £15.25 on Thu and Fri.

Which experts will be at the Show, and when?

Our top line-up can be viewed here – be sure to book a seat in the Big Kitchen with tickets for the full experience, and drop in at the other stages during your day out.
